text:
Hi there, and thanks so much for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Great question. Unfortunately, we don't offer international shipping at the moment, so we're not able to deliver orders outside of our domestic service area.

If you're ordering within our service area, here are a few helpful things to know:
- **Standard shipping** takes 2-8 business days depending on how far you are from our nearest greenhouse.
- **Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only**, so they arrive fresh and healthy.
- **Remote and island addresses** are covered, but they fall into our longest delivery zone (5-8 business days).

If you'd like, I can pass your question along to our team in case there are any updates, or answer anything else about shipping. Just let me know!

Thanks again for thinking of Leafy, and please reach out any time. Happy planting! 🪴
